name: New Jersey Electrical Contractor License Verification

agency.name: New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs Board of Examiners of Electrical Contractors

updateFrequency: real-time lookup; downloadable standard files are periodically dated
knownExclusions: Local permits and inspections remain separate.
Alarm, locksmith, fire-protection equipment, and other contractor credentials use separate official paths.
rateLimitNotes: No automated lookup is implemented. Use official downloads where lawful and do not bypass portal controls.
publicRecordsNotes: The Division advertises free standard licensee lists, but publication and privacy treatment require source-specific approval.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: The Division publishes free standard individual and facility files through its official Box folder; board-specific extraction and field/privacy validation remain to be implemented.
researchNotes: Electrical contractor records are a confirmed bulk-adapter candidate.
maintainerNotes: Future normalization must distinguish individual licenses, business permits, journeyperson records, status, and discipline fields.

researchEvidence.note: Official board page states it licenses electrical contractors and requires a valid business permit.
Official Division page confirms free downloadable standard licensee files and documents their fields.

blocker.summary: The large dated standard files need deterministic discovery, profession filtering, schema validation, and privacy approval before production ingestion.
